primarySources.title: Google Pixel Update and Software Repair

scope: Updated the Japanese recovery article and rewrote all 12 translations against current official Google documentation. Clarifies Pixel 4a+ including Fold support; separates Update (may avoid factory reset) from Reinstall (factory reset and data erasure); corrects the live tool flow, Fastboot steps, general 70% reset charge guidance, backup/account preparation, and lower-risk troubleshooting. Full Hugo production build and 13-page static preview checks passed; no physical device testing.
